gold: IBD-associated neutrophilic dermatosis with ulcerative colitis

selector.rationale: Neutrophilic dermatosis with intradermal neutrophilic inflammation and ulceration, along with systemic symptoms like fever and polyarthralgia, are more characteristic of Sweet syndrome

rejected.label: Erythema nodosum
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic findings such as painful subcutaneous nodules on the lower extremities without other systemic symptoms

rejected.label: Inflammatory bowel disease
rejected.why: Although the patient has a history of diverticulosis and colonic polyps, and colonoscopy shows moderate inflammation, the primary presentation is dermatological
